title: The textbook seller has mutual friends
scenario: A seller in a campus marketplace offers a nearly new textbook at half price. You have several mutual friends, but they want payment by bank transfer before meeting because “too many buyers no-show.”

answers.A: Send a small deposit because mutual friends make the profile trustworthy.
answers.B: Meet in a safe public place and pay after inspecting the book, or use a platform with buyer protection.
answers.C: Ask a mutual friend whether they actually know the seller and arrange an in-person exchange.

explanation: Mutual connections can come from compromised or lightly vetted accounts. Payment protection matters more than social proximity.
proTip: Mutual friends are context, not escrow.
